title: Fix Video Not Auto-Playing on Fluid Mode
description: When loading a song page, the video shows as blurry (paused state) and doesn't auto-play even though Fluid mode is selected. User has to click a line to start playback. Fix so video auto-plays on page load when Fluid mode is enabled.

relevantCode: useEffect that should trigger auto-play after audio files load
YouTubePlayer component and its play/pause methods
symptoms: Video shows blurry/paused on page load
Fluid mode toggle is correctly selected
User must click a line to start playback
After clicking, video plays and lines sync correctly

acceptanceCriteria.text: Read src/routes/song.$songId.tsx to understand current auto-play logic
Identify why auto-play isn't triggering (check useEffect dependencies, conditions)
Check if browser autoplay policy is blocking (need user interaction or muted video)
If autoplay policy issue: start video muted, then unmute after user interaction
If logic issue: fix the useEffect to properly trigger playback when audio files ready
Video MUST start playing automatically within 2 seconds of page load
Lines MUST start highlighting and advancing as video plays
If browser blocks autoplay, show a 'Click to play' overlay that starts playback on click
Fluid mode remains selected (don't change default mode)
Single mode and Loop mode still work correctly after fix

browserAutoplayNotes: Chrome/Safari block autoplay with sound unless:
- User has interacted with the site before
- Site has Media Engagement Index score
Solution: Try autoplay, if it fails, show play button overlay
